ASGE25.name: ASGE periendoscopic GLP-1/SGLT-2 position statement
ASGE25.strength: Modified Delphi; no separate GRADE certainty
ASGE25.limitations: Erratum10.1016/j.gie.2025.02.021 exists; its full text inaccessible. Parsed primary table checked; PDF screenshot unavailable. Do not claim corrected-edition verification.

USMULTI24.name: US multisociety GLP-1 practice guidance
USMULTI24.limitations: Document explicitly is not an evidence-based guideline. If withholding is chosen, ideal duration unknown.

SPAQI25.name: SPAQI GLP-1 multidisciplinary consensus
SPAQI25.strength: Recommendation grades B/C/E, not interchangeable with GRADE certainty
SPAQI25.limitations: Excludes other causes of delayed emptying such as gastroparesis/high-dose opioids.

UK25.name: UK multisociety elective perioperative GLP-1/SGLT2 consensus
UK25.limitations: Shorter SGLT2 scheme conflicts with US endoscopy guidance; no interval guarantees absence of DKA.

ADA26.name: ADA Standards: Diabetes Care in the Hospital

CPOC23.limitations: Prior normal diet and contrast qualifiers matter; not a bowel-prep universal schedule.

BYETTA25.name: FDA Byetta prescribing information

BCISE25.limitations: Applicability only; not holding-duration authority or latest-label certification.

asge-sglt.notHeld: Reschedule or assess BMP for anion-gap acidosis; normal glucose does not exclude euDKA

asge-glp.notHeldOrSymptoms: Anesthesia consultation and multidisciplinary discussion; urgent/time-sensitive cases have separate pathways
asge-glp.restart: Not specified; use separately identified restart source

usmulti-glp.mitigation: Qualified gastric ultrasound; anesthesia airway plan or deferral; no default based solely on obesity

spaqi-glp.restart: Usual diet; prescription-specific missed-dose/retitration rules still apply

uk-sglt.restartOutpatient: Eating/drinking normally, usually24-48h, not automatic by clock
uk-sglt.liverReductionDiet: Stop at diet commencement; adjust glycemic plan

uk-glp.hold: Continue with individualized risk stratification and aspiration mitigation
uk-glp.fasting: Standard local fasting; symptoms alone do not establish empty stomach

ada.oralAgents: Hold metformin and other oral glucose-lowering agents on procedure day
ada.glp: Personalized risk assessment; consider24h liquid nutrition protocol/airway precautions
ada.restart: SGLT2 risk factors resolved and nutritional intake resumed; no guaranteed restart hour

cpoc.metformin: Often continue with normal prior diet if no contrast; TID lunchtime omission; contrast AND eGFR<60: omit procedure day and following48h
cpoc.scope: Not unrestricted continuation of a fixed SGLT2 combination

colonoscopy.metformin: Stop when clear fluids begin; resume meals
colonoscopy.scope: Author suggestions, not formal society recommendation; ertugliflozin4day society distinction retained

exen-ir-renal.notes: ESRD/severe renal impairment not recommended; acute dehydration/renal deterioration needs assessment

exen-er-renal.notes: Not interchangeable with IR CrCl cutoff

lixi-renal.notes: 15 to<30 limited experience/close monitoring; not a renal holding-days table

sglt: Fixed combination contains all listed active ingredients; a selected SGLT2 interruption applies to the whole pill. Do not split it or prescribe replacement components automatically.
Reduced intake, dehydration, prolonged fasting, illness, alcohol and relative insulin deficiency raise ketosis risk; normal glucose is not a rule-out.
Confirm adult T2 indication and actual prescription; cardiorenal monotherapy indications do not automatically authorize a combination.
Stable CKD does not create a different society hold interval; AKI/dehydration and component-specific dosing restrictions require individualized assessment.
Metformin-containing products add dehydration/AKI/hypoxia/hepatic-failure and lactic-acidosis concerns; restart only after appropriate intake and organ-function reassessment.
DPP4 continuation/omission disagreements apply to a separately prescribed component, not permission to continue the SGLT2 combination.
No anticoagulant-like bleed-risk clock or insulin discontinuation is inferred. Replacement glucose management belongs to the treating clinician.
glp: Elective adult EGD/colonoscopy/combined procedures only; emergency/time-sensitive indications require their own risk-benefit pathway.
Assess escalation, dose, actual dosing frequency, nausea/vomiting/oral-intake tolerance, gastroparesis/opioids and anesthesia/airway plan. Absence of symptoms cannot certify an empty stomach.
Prevent dehydration and assess AKI; hepatic impairment/poor nutrition and concurrent insulin or sulfonylurea modify glycemic risk. Do not invent renal/hepatic holding intervals.
Continuation versus withholding and liquid versus clear-liquid schedules are source-specific choices; do not automatically choose the longest or shortest.
Prolonged withholding may require glycemic replacement or retitration. No unscheduled catch-up, dose conversion or product substitution is authorized.
Procedure bleeding-risk classification is not the basis for a GLP1 hold; sedation/aspiration risk and urgency matter.
